title: Review GIDE - Restaurant Review Gastrointestinal Illness Detection and Extraction with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing external survey data (Food Standards Agency and ONS) on catered food consumption and expenditure by household income decile to evaluate representational bias in the restaurant review dataset.
Stratifying reviews by language type (traditional vs. non-traditional/slang/unconventional spelling) and comparing the LLMs' classification performance (micro-F1) across the groups.
Using Social Group Substitution (counterfactual term replacement) to swap male and female terms in reviews, then comparing classification accuracy across the original and synthetic groups.
Using Social Group Substitution to replace terms implying a married couple (e.g., 'wife') with unmarried equivalents (e.g., 'girlfriend') and comparing classification accuracy across the groups.
